fields.statement: At 8e90ac317, in throwaway worktrees (not committed): with pollDebounce raised to 10s as the injected delay and r.settle() removed from stepRunner.Evidence, go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/headless-run-agent-tabs$' failed twice with 'verifier ended with neither Evidence nor findings' (the flake); with the same delay and the fix it passed 3 consecutive runs. Without the fix, go test ./internal/api -run TestEvidenceReadsPastSessionWrites failed (Evidence after the session's writes = false; want true). Without the delay, at the leaf commit: headless-run-agent-tabs -count=5 ok, go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... ok, go test -trimpath ./internal/run/... ok. The script has no skip or quarantine. Diff read: settle() under modelMu sets catchUpNext, refreshDue honours it, catchUpModel clears it after a catch-up.
